# What is your workers' comp premium really made of?

> Free workers' compensation premium calculator for contractors and small employers: class-code rates, experience mod, overtime exclusion, schedule debit, premium discount and the audit true-up. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
